headline: Launch faster with a page that writes itself
subhead: A sample landing page rendered from a JSON data file and a generated hero image.

sections.heading: Describe it
sections.body: Give the generator a topic, audience, and tone. It drafts the copy and a hero image prompt for you.

sections.heading: Generate it
sections.body: The hero image is created server-side and saved into the repo, so nothing is hotlinked.

sections.heading: Ship it
sections.body: Each page is a static route backed by a single data file you can edit by hand.

heroImageAlt: Neutral gray gradient placeholder for the landing page hero
